# arc-agentkit

> A low-level, composable Python framework for building AI agents. Provider-neutral (`claude()`, `openai()`, `deepseek()`, `openrouter()`, `ClaudeCliCognition`, or your own `LLMPort`); typed seams throughout; zero core runtime dependencies; `mypy --strict` clean.

Organized around four themes: cognition (how the agent decides), control (what limits its authority), state (what it knows), behaviour (how each call is intercepted).

## Getting started
- [Landing](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/): pain-first intro and four-theme mental model.
- [Why agentkit](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/why/): concrete guarantees and honest comparison.
- [Getting started](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/getting-started/): install and first call.
- [Tutorial](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/tutorial/): fifteen-minute walkthrough.
- [Cheatsheet](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/cheatsheet/): every primitive on one page.
- [Anti-patterns](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/anti-patterns/): shapes that void the framework's guarantees.

## Concepts
- [Kernel](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/concepts/kernel/): opinion-free value types + Protocol ports.
- [Runtime](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/concepts/runtime/): RunContext + Invoker + Budget/Quota.
- [Agents](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/concepts/agents/): Agent + Cognition Protocol.
- [Capabilities](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/concepts/capabilities/): RequestBuilder + Compactor + Guardrail + Checkpointer + Evaluator.
- [Middlewares](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/concepts/middlewares/): tracing / retry / meter / memoize / compaction / security / audit / egress.
- [Prompts](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/concepts/prompts/): versioned Prompt values.

## Recipes (indexed by problem)
- [Pick a provider from config](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/provider-from-env/): model registry — from-env provider resolution + per-model capability declaration refused at bind time.
- [Stream a typed object](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/stream-typed-output/): StreamEvent.partial_output — the in-progress typed object on every delta, via Agent.stream alone.
- [Control cost](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/spend-budget-and-quota/): Budget + Quota, MeterExceeded.
- [Pause for a human](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/hitl-tool-approval/): Autonomy tier + Suspended + resume().
- [Elicit a value from a human](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/elicit-a-value-from-a-human/): Elicitation/Decision/Asker — value requests, parkable in place, deadlined, typed, secret-safe.
- [Survive a crash](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/resume-after-crash/): Checkpointer + resume-after-crash pattern.
- [Parallel agents with cancellation](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/parallel-agents-with-cancellation/): gather_bounded / run_agents / CancellationToken.
- [Custom middleware](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/custom-middleware/): (call, next) contract, BaseMiddleware.
- [OpenTelemetry](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/otel-tracing-and-metrics/): TracePort / MetricsPort wiring.
- [Local Claude Code, no API key](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/claude-cli-fastapi-code-gen/): ClaudeCliCognition + FastAPI SSE.
- [Any MCP server](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/recipes/mcp-tools/): MCPClient + mcp_tools / mcp_resources / mcp_prompts.

## Migrating
- [From LangChain](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/migrating/from-langchain/): concept-by-concept mapping.
- [From vanilla asyncio + provider SDK](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/migrating/from-vanilla-asyncio/): loop + primitives.

## Reference
- [agents](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/agents/): Agent, Workflow, Cognition, control primitives.
- [runtime](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/runtime/): RunContext, Invoker, Budget, Quota, EventBus.
- [kernel](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/kernel/): value types, ports, middleware contract, resilience, concurrency.
- [capabilities](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/capabilities/): RequestBuilder, Compactor, Guardrail, Checkpointer, Evaluator.
- [middlewares](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/middlewares/): tracing, retry, meter, memoize, compaction, security, audit, egress.
- [context](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/context/): WorkingContext, ContextScope, TokenCounter.
- [memory](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/memory/): MemorySource, VectorMemory, CompositeMemory, ScopedMemory.
- [tools](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/tools/): Tool, FunctionTool, ToolRegistry, @tool decorator.
- [prompts](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/prompts/): Prompt value type.
- [skills](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/skills/): Skill facade (prompt + cognition + tools + memory as one unit).
- [adapters](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/adapters/): LLM providers, vector, store, checkpoint, observer.
- [testing](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/api-reference/testing/): FakeLLM, FakeFetch, FakeSearch, FakeMemory, FakeCtx.

## Examples
- [Examples index](https://arc-labs-ai.github.io/agentkit/examples/): runnable end-to-end scripts under `examples/` in the repo.
